title: Postcomposition naturality of the explicit Koszul class
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$. Let $L,F$ be arbitrary integer cochain complexes of $O_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}$-modules, $e\in\mathbb N$, $s:\widetilde I_e\to L$ and $t:L\to F$. Assume the derived categories of sheaf modules on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and of $A$-modules as in the Lean statement [def-pc-derived-category]. Define $z_e(L,s)$ to be koszulOpenHomStageClass [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives], followed by $H^0(Q(\iota_e))$ and by $H^0(\operatorname{koszulCechDerivedComparison}(L))$ [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Write $G$ for the right derived functor of affineOpenSections at $U=\bigcup_jD(f_j)$ [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Then $H^0(G(Q(t)))(z_e(L,s))=z_e(F,s\,t)$. No quasi-coherence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 36.9.5; Tag 08DC equation 36.9.4.1 and Tag 08D1 signed comparison; Tag 09M1 structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Adjunction transposition commutes with postcomposition by t; Hom-complex cycles, the homology projection, homologyFunctorFactors, and the specified stage object iso therefore take the class of s to the class of s followed by t.

The A-linear coefficient map t commutes with restrictions, with the invertible denominators on each principal intersection, and with the integer sign. Hence the explicit cocones and their colimit injections commute with postcomposition. The Cech derived comparison is natural by its defining K-injective resolution equation. Apply Q and H^0 and their composition laws to obtain the formula; empty covers and zero objects satisfy the same identities.

proof_origin.note: Postcomposition commutes with adjunction transposition and Hom cycles, the explicit localized signed cocone, its colimit map, and the resolution-characterized Cech comparison. Source read online; independently reviewed by Q2.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpenHom_chain_class_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (L F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : ℕ) (s : koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e ⟶ L) (t : L ⟶ F) :
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    H.map (G.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map t))
      (H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f L)
        (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
          (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
            (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)) e))
          (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f L e s))) =
    H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f F)
      (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
        (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
          (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)) e))
        (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f F e (s ≫ t)))
